title: Area-code shard C pass 36 — 914 / 917 / 920

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public organizational actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 914, 917, and 920?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public organizational-role enumeration, seed-family expansion, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay/locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Added Westchester Community Empowerment Organization from its direct 914 contact and current first-party Westchester service pages, plus ReSET Westchester from current 2026 refugee/asylum-family support. WCEO's six publicly listed board officers/directors are retained only in their directly stated organizational roles; no ideology inferred.

Added current NYC Anarchist Black Cross after first-party re-verification of its explicit anarchist-collective self-description, ABCF support-group relation, September 2026 activity and public communication surfaces. Added Another World as a current Crown Heights movement center explicitly rooted in abolitionist communism; it is not relabeled anarchist. Its stated founding-by-CARE-members edge remains an unresolved organization endpoint pending separate identity resolution.

Added Hope Fridge as a current first-party self-described mutual-aid project operating 24/7 Menasha and Oshkosh community fridges, and Common Roots Rising as a current Fox Cities community collective with active 2026 mutual-aid networking. Mark and Savi Gehrke are retained only as directly stated Common Roots Rising founders. Food Not Bombs Fox Valley remains a current-status follow-up lead because this bounded pass did not confirm a sufficiently strong current first-party chapter surface.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-organizational-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public organizational-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 914, 917, and 920.
